I was truly impressed by the prompt and professional service provided by the entire team. Every staff member maintained excellent hygiene standards, wearing gloves and following proper safety protocols, which made the dining experience both comfortable and reassuring.

A special thanks to Ankur Sharma for going above and beyond by thoughtfully arranging a dish for us that wasn’t even on the menu — that personal touch made our experience even more memorable.

The hospitality extended beyond the restaurant as well. The staff at the amusement park were incredibly welcoming, attentive, and genuinely committed to delivering their best service. Their positive attitude and dedication truly enhanced our overall experience.

We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to Avnish for relentlessly working to make our family trip truly special. He took care of every minute detail and even managed our eleventh-hour requests with complete dedication and a smile. His behaviour was exceptional, and every member of our family genuinely appreciated his warmth and professionalism.

A special thanks to Rakesh ji, the Food & Beverages Incharge, who was constantly on his toes ensuring everything was perfectly arranged. Together, both of them made our stay a lifetime memory.

Undoubtedly, the location of Apno Ghar is excellent—well connected to the city and very convenient. The rooms were comfortable, safety arrangements were reassuring, the food was delicious, and the entire staff was extremely cooperative and supportive throughout our stay.

The most touching part was that not a single staff member asked for money for their extra efforts. They served us wholeheartedly, always with priceless smiles on their faces. This beautiful attitude truly won our hearts. Many of our friends and family members are already looking forward to visiting Apno Ghar again and again in the future.

Truly, Apno Ghar ne humein mehmaan nahin, apne ghar ka hissa bana liya. ❤️

We had a very pleasant and memorable stay at Aapno Ghar. The amusement park within the property was excellent, with a wide range of enjoyable and well-managed rides that added a lot of fun to our visit.

The hospitality deserves special mention. The staff was courteous, respectful, and always ready to help, ensuring we were comfortable throughout our stay. We truly appreciated the care and attention given to guests by Ankur Sharma!

The food was another highlight — fresh, tasty, and served with great quality and variety. Overall, it was a relaxing and enjoyable experience, and we would happily recommend this resort to others looking for a family-friendly getaway.
